initial_cew_b11_tasks.goal: Find TAV-05A from the project without knowing its repository path and identify its discipline, level, status and original file.
initial_cew_b11_tasks.success_condition: Correct drawing opened from Document/Drawing Workspace and primary-source status understood.

initial_cew_b11_tasks.goal: Open TAV-05A in a readable orientation, rotate the view if necessary and return to the original orientation without modifying the SourceVersion.
initial_cew_b11_tasks.success_condition: User can read the drawing and understands rotation as viewer state only.

initial_cew_b11_tasks.goal: Navigate from TAV-05A to the G01-R06 evidence and back to the complete drawing context.
initial_cew_b11_tasks.success_condition: Source -> evidence -> source round trip succeeds without internal IDs.

initial_cew_b11_tasks.goal: Distinguish the primary PDF from a derived 300 dpi reading aid.
initial_cew_b11_tasks.success_condition: User correctly identifies authority and reproducibility states.

extended_b1_tasks.goal: Select a file already present in N12 and understand that the exact hash means duplicate, with no upload required.
extended_b1_tasks.success_condition: EXACT_DUPLICATE understood; no new SourceVersion expected; local-hash privacy boundary understood.

extended_b1_tasks.goal: Select a changed file and deliberately identify it as a possible new version of an existing Source.
extended_b1_tasks.success_condition: NEW_VERSION_CANDIDATE understood as a human decision, not an automatic version binding.

extended_b1_tasks.goal: Distinguish registered metadata, machine candidates, human-validated document features and unknown fields.
extended_b1_tasks.success_condition: No candidate/validated document feature is mistaken for DOC, EvidenceRegion or structural binding.

extended_b1_tasks.goal: Select a region on a governed drawing and understand that the result is an EvidenceRegionCandidate awaiting F2 review.
extended_b1_tasks.success_condition: Correct region/page context retained; candidate not mistaken for approved EvidenceRegion or Observation.

release_rule: A user-facing slice cannot be marked product-complete solely from CI. Applicable representative tasks must have HVA/usability evidence and no unresolved critical authority/provenance misunderstanding. B1 release additionally requires all extended_b1_tasks applicable to the promoted runtime and zero critical authority false successes.
